projects.title: Giro Rápido — SaaS Platform for Laundromats
projects.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for franchisees to run fully self-service, unattended laundromats: the customer identifies themselves at the kiosk, picks a machine and starts the cycle, with credits debited automatically. Back-end in Clean Architecture (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API) with JWT Bearer authentication, event-driven architecture with RabbitMQ/MassTransit for the machine cycle, and a feature-based React 19 front-end with three interfaces: touch kiosk, franchisee dashboard and customer area.

projects.title: AzurePrep — AZ-900 Exam Practice Test
projects.description: A Microsoft Azure Fundamentals practice exam that replicates the real test experience — timer, linear navigation, review screen and score report — with a fully original question bank written from the official Skills Measured outline. Clean Architecture with lightweight DDD and unit tests (xUnit) from day one. Custom authentication (no ASP.NET Identity): cookies, OAuth/OIDC (Google, GitHub, LinkedIn) and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 hashing. Two-layer brute-force protection and server-side Pix QR Code generation, validated against the Central Bank of Brazil's BR Code manual.
